os_matrix.note: A second operating system cannot be measured on this machine; the CI matrix is the only place it can be run.

security.limit: AGSC-08-19: these lints prove neither safety nor the absence of novel injection. An implementation MUST NOT claim more.

perf.command: node bench/measure.js --layer perf --scratch <dir> --sizes 100,500,1000,5000,10000 --runs 3   # 2026-09-25, after the write-path change

before_write_path_change.command: node bench/measure.js --layer perf   # sizes 100 500 1000 5000 10000, 3 runs each, median

parity.note: Compared as values after a JSON round trip, which is what AGSC-09-16 claims at rc.6; never byte-identical across the browser boundary.

tokens.no_claude_count: Anthropic publishes no offline tokenizer; no Claude token count is reported, because it would be a guess.

a11y.ceiling: axe-core finds on average 57 % of WCAG issues automatically; zero violations is a floor, never a conformance claim.

cost.command: scratch scripts over a loopback server (page weight: playwright-core 1.62.1 + chrome-headless-shell 1228; MCP: one `agsc mcp` process over stdio, 20 calls per tool, median); 2026-09-25

page_weight.note: requests and bytes one visit costs, measured in a real headless Chromium; "plain" is a browser without document.modelContext, "webmcp" one that exposes it

mcp_stdio.note: per-call wall time and answer bytes, median of 20; startup = process start to the initialize answer (one in-memory build)

cold_start.command: /usr/bin/time -f "%e s %M KB" node bin/agsc.js <verb>; modules counted from require.cache at exit

quotes: Cloudflare Pages sites can contain up to 20,000 files on the Free plan.
Paid plans (such as Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans) can have up to 100,000 files per site.
The maximum file size for a single Cloudflare Pages site asset is 25 MiB.
A `_headers` file can have a maximum of 100 header rules.
A `_redirects` file can have a maximum of 2,000 static redirects and 100 dynamic redirects, for a combined total of 2,100 redirects.
On both free and paid plans, requests to static assets are free and unlimited.

bench_10000.needs: a paid Pages plan (100,000 files; its price was not read in this run) or another hosting profile
